_help: Source of truth for the wall. Order here = order on the site. Put the scan in originals/<id>.(webp|jpg|png), then run: python3 tools/build.py. 'frame' adds a border in the drawing's own background colour, as a fraction of the image's longest side on each edge (0 = leave as is). 'trim' shaves N pixels off each edge first (e.g. a scanner hairline). 'tags' are ids from the tags list; a work can have several.
